blockers.quote: Theo's ten lines become eleven: the program that counted the number now sends it.
blockers.why: Check #16 fails: one extra line of code suddenly gains access to every debt and solves the climax through an unplanted capability.
blockers.fix: At line 38, plant Halloran's bulk loan-clearing file and show Theo adapting his program to it. Replace this sentence with: "Theo opens the payoff file he began after Halloran showed him the clearing format. The first batch rejects; Halloran repairs the account map, and Theo runs it again."

blockers.quote: You both guess day thirty-one might buy a flat with a view.
blockers.why: Check #7 fails: you state the wrong belief, but you do not act on it before the program disproves it.
blockers.fix: Replace with: "You put down a deposit on a flat because you think day thirty-one might just cover it. Before the agent leaves, Theo runs the program: $1,073,741,824."

blockers.quote: Day ten is the first morning you buy one without looking.
blockers.why: Check #6 fails: this use produces exactly the expected coffee, with no gap between expectation and result.
blockers.fix: Replace with: "Day ten is five hundred and twelve. You buy the coffee without looking. Then you look anyway. Same cup, same chair, and your thumb still checks the number."

suggestions.quote: Keep going and on day two hundred and sixty-seven there are more dollars than atoms in the observable universe (about 10^80).
suggestions.fix: Move the atoms and Hungary material to the sequel or description; let the day-forty-nine debt deadline own this beat without two later futures competing with it.

suggestions.quote: The choice is morally live: three billion strangers' debts erased without anyone asking, and Mrs. Vance said no, and you keep that.
suggestions.fix: Keep one refusal active until the final minutes so consent and stopping the power remain two defensible choices; Mrs. Vance currently reverses before any choice is required.

suggestions.quote: A chessboard chalked on the counter, one grain of rice on square one, doubled on each.
suggestions.fix: Make the familiar chessboard demonstration causally damage the scene: the accumulating rice blocks the till, spills into the coffee urn and forces Mrs. Vance to close the counter before the imagined city burial.
